layers.name: Odoo 18 ERP Backend
layers.description: Odoo 18.0 (PostgreSQL 16) single source of truth for HR attendance, employees, fleet, and accounting.

layers.name: FastAPI Gateway
layers.description: High-performance async Python backend providing REST APIs, authentication, and XML-RPC bridge to Odoo.

layers.name: Supervisor Tablet App
layers.description: Frontline supervisor attendance tracking and vehicle dispatch client with kiosk mode.

layers.name: Admin Management Portal
layers.description: Management web interface for approvals, compensation configuration, and Odoo ERP sync.

layers.name: Shared Package SDK
layers.description: Universal ES Module library with TanStack Query hooks, API client, and shared UI components.

layers.name: Infrastructure & Config
layers.description: Docker compose multi-container orchestration, environment configuration, and root assets.

tour.title: System Architecture Overview
tour.description: Explore the multi-tier architecture powered by Odoo 18.0 PostgreSQL backend, FastAPI gateway, and Vite React frontends.

tour.title: Odoo ERP & Database Adapter
tour.description: Inspect the OdooDatabaseAdapter replacing MongoDB with direct XML-RPC models for hr.employee and hr.attendance.

tour.title: FastAPI Endpoints & Real-time Sync
tour.description: REST endpoints handling instant attendance updates, payroll statistics, and session lifecycle.

tour.title: Supervisor Tablet Interface
tour.description: Supervisor attendance marking (On Time, Arrived, Absent) and vehicle dispatch workflow.

tour.title: Admin Management Portal & Odoo Sync
tour.description: Admin web portal for monitoring workforce, managing compensation, and triggering Odoo ERP synchronization.

tour.title: Shared SDK & ESM Package
tour.description: Standardized ES module exports with React Query hooks, auth service, and API client.
